question.text: Three moles of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>AgCl</mi></math> get precipitated when one mole of an octahedral co-ordination compound with empirical formula <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>CrCl</mi><mn>3</mn></msub><mo>.</mo><mn>3</mn><msub><mi>NH</mi><mn>3</mn></msub><mo>.</mo><mn>3</mn><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></math> reacts with excess of silver nitrate. The number of chloride ions satisfying the secondary valency of the metal ion is ______ .

solution.text:
Mole of AgCl precipitated is equal the mole of Cl- present in ionization sphere.

Since none of Cl- is present in the co ordination sphere. Therefore answer is zero.
